The back door component appears to use an open-source HTTP client called Ryeol to communicate with the C&C servers.
 [C&C SERVER ADDRESS]/allusers/2093101001.rou2093101001.txt If the configuration update is unavailable, the default .rou configuration file is used.
To do this, it calls the WebCamCapture export in \ntsvc32\CamCap.dll keylog Logs keystrokes and saves them in the main log file msc Captures window titles or text that the mouse clicked.
Backdoor.Remexi and Backdoor.Remexi.B Backdoor.Remexi is a basic back door that lets the attackers open a remote shell and execute commands.
 HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\services\SEA\Parameters\Arguments For Backdoor.Remexi.B, the service may be called “MAS”.
